source: This linear dependence onZXMATH0000XZ is easy to underestimate. The cache grows with sequence length, batch size, layer count, KV-head count, head width, and storage precision. The model weights may fit comfortably while the cache still constrains the number of concurrent long-context requests.
zh: 这种对 ZXMATH0000XZ 的线性依赖性很容易被低估。缓存随着序列长度、批量大小、层数、KV 头数、头宽度和存储精度而增长。模型权重可以很好地适应，而缓存仍然限制并发长上下文请求的数量。
